decisions.reason: The construction site dumper appears to have had the weakest visible commitment in 2019 and, given the firm's quick earlier withdrawal of mining vehicles, management is less likely to keep escalating support for this more weakly signalled product.

The inclined furniture lift had its own product page and fits a clearer lifting-equipment line, so prior investment and public commitment make management more inclined to continue it and attribute any weak sales to temporary market factors.

The inclined building material lift was prominently presented and sits in the same strategic product family as the other inclined lifts, which encourages continued commitment despite uncertain recent evidence.

The truck-mounted inclined furniture lift likely required meaningful development and was publicly showcased on its own page, so escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to abandon it unless disappointment becomes unmistakable.
